title: Title Part: Titles, Generated Titles and Display Text | Orchard Core
description:
A content item without a display text is listed under the name of its content type, which makes it hard to recognize in the lists of the admin.

The Title part gives a content type a title. Editors can type it, be required to type it, or let Orchard Core generate it from the other fields of the item with a pattern, while the Title field is disabled or hidden.

In this video:
• Why content items need a display text, and the four settings of the Behavior option
• Adding the Title part to a content type and opening its settings
• Typed titles, and requiring the editor to type one
• Generated titles built from a pattern
• Generating a title without showing the Title field
